rationale: The condition establishes which component withdrawals and restorations can be carried out in a traversable flow and documents practical limits. Recording navigation patches flags concurrent changes without establishing that they are causally irrelevant. These checks enable the mapped procedure without themselves changing its mechanism, warrant or target.

if_execution.verification_or_satisfaction_method: Check each component's withdrawal, flow traversal and restoration; record any navigation patches as concurrent changes and list components that cannot be tested.
